title: Shared definitions
description: The pieces §17.3 names besides the five artifacts: typed failures, diagnostics, per-case outcomes, resource envelopes, and the analysis identity every artifact keys on.

digest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 with an explicit algorithm prefix, so a future algorithm cannot be mistaken for this one.

identityProfile.description: The rules for what an analysis identity is and how it is encoded. A successor ships either a total mechanical mapping from its predecessor or a stated reason none exists.

stableSourceKey.description: The identity a construct carries in its authored source: the MSA or entry GUID on the LibLCM path, the id attribute on HC XML. Never a compiler-assigned ordinal.

analysisIdentity.description: A self-contained value (ADR 0006). Never a reference resolved against a compiled model, so it stays meaningful after the grammar that produced it changed or stopped compiling.

morphemes.description: Ordered stable morpheme keys. A null slot is the fabricated root of a guessed analysis, which by construction has no authored source — distinct from a morpheme whose key is literally the string "null".

rootIndex.description: Position of the root within morphemes. -1 where no root is identified.

category.description: Stable part-of-speech symbol id, or null when the analysis carries no category.

budgetDimension.description: Which magnitude a logical budget counts. Closed, so a consumer can branch on it.

incompleteReason.description: Why a case that started could not finish. Only a logical budget is deterministic; a wall-clock stop makes the report unreproducible.

caseOutcomeKind.description: Atomic per-case outcome. A complete empty analysis set is a positive claim that the grammar analyzes the form no way at all; incomplete is the refusal to make that claim.

batchOutcome.description: The report-level verdict on execution, never on the grammar.

resourceEnvelope.description: Effective logical budgets by dimension. Absent or empty means unbounded, which is the default until an envelope is named.

diagnostic.description: An importer or compiler diagnostic. `code` is what compare diffs; `message` is for humans and never reaches a digest.

extensions.description: Namespaced consumer annotations. Excluded from both semantic projections, included in reportId.

assessmentFailure.description: Why the whole run failed (17.7). Null means it did not. Distinct from a per-case outcome: a not_attempted case says nothing about why the run could not proceed, and a consumer may have no access to the producer's exit code.
